summary.intent: Resolve open CodeRabbit review threads on a CipherBox PR after Greptile and CI were already green, triage findings, apply fixes, and push.
summary.outcome: Fixed 5 of 7 open CodeRabbit threads (same-sequence guard, re-enroll reactivation, validate-before-upload reorder, queue resource leak, currentEpoch fail-closed test); deferred 2 (EOL assertion and a rename); all suites and e2e passed, commit pushed.

repo: parseIpnsRecord / ParsedIpnsRecord exposes only value/sequence/signatureV2/data/pubKey — no validity or EOL fields; asserting EOL requires a crypto-package change or manual CBOR decode.
Re-enrolling a folder in republish.service.ts only refreshed nextRepublishAt and never flipped active back on, leaving re-enrolled rows permanently absent from getDueEntries.
Pre-existing typecheck errors in sdk-core (cas.test.ts, share/grant.test.ts — ReadGrantPayload/never) do not gate CI; they were present before the session's changes.
After any publish-path change, rebuild sdk-core + sdk + api and re-run the e2e round-trip before committing.

code.finding: Same-sequence guard (TEE-02) was absent before publish; a misbehaving TEE could push a duplicate sequence number. Guard added to enforce invariant at the relay.
Re-enroll path only refreshed nextRepublishAt; stale re-enrolled folders never rejoined the batch. Fixed by also reactivating the row.
teeKeys validation/wrap block was placed after IPFS seal+upload, risking orphaned blobs if TEE validation fails. Moved before upload.
Queue resource leak: missing try/finally around queue consumer; fixed so the queue is always cleaned up even on test failure.
Added fail-closed test for currentEpoch: verifies that a missing/invalid currentEpoch causes createSubfolder to throw rather than silently proceed.

workflow: CodeRabbit bundles review findings in the PR review body (not inline threads); sweep threads via gh API after each fix batch to track open/resolved counts.
Triage CodeRabbit findings into fix/check/defer before touching code; 'Heavy lift' label from CodeRabbit is a reliable signal to defer rename/refactor items.
Rebuild all transitive packages (sdk-core → sdk → api) and re-run e2e after any publish-path edit, not just unit tests.

friction: Pre-existing typecheck errors in sdk-core test files triggered a false alarm after changes — had to grep error locations to confirm none were in modified files.
EOL assertion for IPNS records (CodeRabbit thread ipns-signer.test.ts:69) is blocked by ParsedIpnsRecord not exposing validity/EOL; required deferral rather than a straightforward test addition.
open_items: EOL assertion in ipns-signer.test.ts:69 — needs crypto-package change to expose validity/EOL from ParsedIpnsRecord (tracked in existing EOL todo).
Rename in apps/api/src/republish/republish.ts:61 — CodeRabbit flagged as 'Heavy lift'; deferred to existing rename todo.
Pre-existing TypeScript errors in packages/sdk-core/src/folder/cas.test.ts and share/grant.test.ts (ReadGrantPayload/never) are not CI-gating but remain unresolved.
